newsitem.title: USA: AFTER THE BELL - Trading in line with close.
newsitem.headline: AFTER THE BELL - Trading in line with close.

text.p: Trading volume after hours was light and mostly in line with the closing prices, traders said.
"It has been quiet from the close on," a trader said.
Late in the trading day BellSouth Corp said it would buy Wireless Cable of Atlanta Inc for $43.5 million in stock.
American Express Co reported its third quarter earnings after the close, posting net income of $0.95 per share compared to $0.83 per share last year.
